title: PixelParityCorpusEntry
description: Schema for a single pixel-parity corpus scene entry.

scenePath.description: Relative path to the .etsc scene file.

goldenPath.description: Relative path to the committed golden PNG.

gpuToleranceMean.description: Optional override for GPU path mean tolerance. Defaults to toleranceMean.

gpuToleranceMax.description: Optional override for GPU path max tolerance. Defaults to toleranceMax.

skipAdapters.description: List of adapter names to skip for this scene (e.g., ['Lavapipe']).

notes.description: Human-readable notes about known driver-specific behavior.
